figurative_meaning_en: To be rescued or escape from danger
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে দুর্ঘটনা থেকে জাল ছেঁড়া হয়ে বেঁচে গেছে।
ব্যবসায়িক সংকট থেকে জাল ছেঁড়া করে উঠলেন তিনি।
example_sentences_in_english: He narrowly escaped from the accident, like breaking through a net.
She managed to escape the business crisis unharmed.
history: Originating from fishing metaphors in rural Bengal, symbolizing fishermen or animals breaking free from nets to represent survival from peril.
note: The idiom draws from agrarian and fishing imagery prevalent in Bengali folklore.
